phone_parity_extractor.warning: Do not use the historical heavy default for native full-v1 parity. Match confidence, orientation pass plan and timestamp semantics explicitly; host ms/frame is not device fps.

historical_research_boundary: ops/tools/motion_models contains frozen UI-PRMD, grouped phone RGB and course-specific research candidates. These are not app-integrated general 25-area models; do not reopen their previously used holdouts or transfer laboratory/publisher labels into first-party expert truth.
large_changes_proposal_only: Gravita three dedicated missing course/variant definitions
Ostinato finger/key/contact or broader instrument-specific feedback

Existing extract_landmarks.py timestamps are frame-index/fps, not original variable-rate PTS: intake blocks VFR timing calibration until a compatible PTS-preserving extractor proposal is accepted. No timestamp rewrite in this change.
device_run_card: Read connected physical device via existing authorized tools; preserve denial/service failures, no reset/pairing/security changes.
Probe existing machine-runtime flock and native marker; acquire both only for an actual exclusive session. A free probe does not reserve a later slot.
Before capture: source SHA, exact installed package/model/rules hashes, device/OS/camera/lens/audio rate/rotation/mirror and timestamp mapping recorded.
Replay exact private clip with pinned full-v1 extractor and app rules; compare native/host landmarks and metrics with missing/occluded frames retained. No new threshold selected on test.

Physical session: permission denial/recovery, start/stop/background/foreground/interruption, owner isolation, monotonically mapped time, dropped-frame denominator, sustained fps/heat and audio latency.
Teacher/learner independently checks the same tasks and observed failure/uncertainty. Native launch/simulator/synthetic pass cannot close physical inference or teaching acceptance.
execution_sequence: First-party original pilot + usage permissions + known movement/lesson. Technical ingest and human observability/identity review; no learned result from a single clip.
Freeze participant/session/source families and intended target conditions before extraction. Demonstration footage is separate from independent evaluation; a single performer cannot fill all splits.

Run existing pinned full pose extractor/DSP only on reference/train and validation. Reject unverified VFR timing for the existing index/fps extractor. Preserve undetected frames and human uncertainty.

Derive task-specific rule/reference calibration on reference/train only, or propose a bounded identity/rejection head if justified. Fit any imputation/scaling/normalization on train only; choose hyperparameters/thresholds with validation only. No backbone training is implemented here.

Freeze exact course/labels/split, extractor code+model, calibration/model artifact and validation result. Open the heldout test once; no tuning on test. Seen historical research holdouts cannot become new independent evidence.
Evaluate by heldout person/device/view and all eligible clips, retaining abstentions and negative controls. Compare frozen baseline and candidate without reusing test to select either.

After frozen offline result, compare native vs host on authorized physical device and then collect actual teaching/learner evidence per lesson. Promote only the demonstrated task and scope; no automatic 25-area mastery or store acceptance.
evaluation_requirements: Task identity and negative-control false accepts, per-class precision/recall/confusion and unobservable/abstention rates with full denominators.
Event/phase/count precision/recall and timestamp error against independent human labels; no model-output oracle.
Where an angular/ROM claim is intended, use an independently defined reference measurement and report error/repeatability by view and person; no medical normative threshold inferred from videos.
For original audio: note/chord identity, onset/offset/timing and silence/noise/octave confusion, with actual capture rate and latency. A video-only sample cannot validate audio feedback.

People/sessions/devices and recording families are the independence units; many frames/edits do not create new participants. Acceptance criteria must be defined for each task before its holdout is opened; this package invents no success percentage.
test_policy: Freeze the full master manifest before extraction/split tuning. Keep participant/session/source-recording/hash groups disjoint across all five products. One-person demonstrations alone cannot produce independent evaluation. Freeze candidate/pipeline/validation receipt before one-shot test-open marker; never reset ID/root/marker to reuse seen holdout.
